verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an official MCP integration that lets users manage domains 'just by talking to an AI assistant': checking availability, registering domains, viewing domains and account info, and reviewing nameservers and DNS records. Its AI Domain Search also turns a keyword or phrase into domain suggestions. The listed MCP actions cover only a subset of the 120+ API actions, and DNS is listed as 'review', with no editing shown. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control beyond the listed core actions (e.g. DNS edits, transfers, renewals, aftermarket bids), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the MCP works as claimed.
